cards.title: Seven bosses, redone
cards.text: Every boss you sent back is rebuilt. Live as 0.18.0. Each has its own card after this one.
cards.why: Your boss answers, built on the stronger model this time. I watched them before sending: the fights read, and each move asks for something different.
cards.details:
How hard: in 100 test fights each, at the level the campaign meets them, the party wins 44 to 56. Those levels are from before the XP change, so I will re-measure after a fresh campaign.

Still to do: no sounds for the new moves. The Bone King and the Elder Ent still flash fully white when struck; the seven here only blink.

cards.title: The Great Engine
cards.text: One machine now: a furnace head on a cog and two jointed arms, a hammer and a claw.
cards.why: You wanted an arm segment between head and hands, and said the spin did not look good at all. Each move is a part: mark the ones that are still weak.
cards.details: One clip a stage of the fight, in order. Its steam uses the game's round dust puffs, which look bubbly up close.

parts.title: Hammer Fall
parts.text: The hammer climbs up the screen and drops. Scatter, then pile on it while it's stuck.

parts.title: Claw Grab
parts.text: The claw shoots out on its pistons and hauls a hero to the furnace mouth. Hit the claw to free them.

parts.title: Whirl
parts.text: Replaces the spin: arms locked straight out, the whole body turning like a rotor, then dizzy. Run.

parts.title: Furnace Beam
parts.text: A white-hot sweep. Get behind a boiler.

parts.title: Pressure
parts.text: Break the valve before the gauge hits red, or the boiler blows.

parts.title: Welder drones
parts.text: A broken hand is forged back by two drones, not a timer. Kill them.

cards.title: The Sand Wurm
cards.text: Built again round the burrow: it lives under the sand and can only be hit out of it.
cards.why: You said: just no. Each move is a part: mark the ones that are still weak.
cards.details: One clip a stage of the fight, in order. It wakes as the party walks in; walking up to a sleeping mound was 25 seconds of nothing.

parts.title: Under
parts.text: A mound runs across the room with crust tipping off its front and a furrow behind.

parts.title: Breach
parts.text: The ground lifts, sand jets, and it arcs out of one hole into another. Get off the ground, then hit the body as it pours past.

parts.title: Lunge
parts.text: Reared up, it strikes down a line. Sidestep, then hit the stuck head.

parts.title: Inhale
parts.text: It pulls everyone to its maw, then the jaws snap. Run against the pull.

parts.title: Quicksand
parts.text: From its second stage the holes stay as quicksand and scarabs crawl out.

parts.title: The Coil
parts.text: Last stage: the mound circles the party and the ring bursts. Stand in the middle.

cards.title: Cinder, the Old Drake
cards.text: An animal that walks: four stepping legs, a body that follows its head, a prowl round its mark.
cards.why: You said it was stuck in one spot, and didn't like the art or the look of its attacks. Each move is a part: mark the ones that are still weak.
cards.details: One clip a stage of the fight, in order. The scorch is a dense carpet of flames; fewer, bigger tongues might read better on a phone.

parts.title: Bite
parts.text: Keep off its mouth.

parts.title: Scorch
parts.text: The game's own fire down a slowly turning cone. Get behind a pillar.

parts.title: Tail Sweep
parts.text: Don't stand behind it, or break the blade off its tail.

parts.title: Rush
parts.text: Get out of the lane; a pillar dazes it.

parts.title: Fire Call
parts.text: A fireball on each hero. Split up.

parts.title: Ring of Fire
parts.text: It runs a full circle round the party laying flame, then scorches into the pen.

parts.title: Molten
parts.text: Last stage: fire drips where it walks.

cards.title: The angel
cards.text: The Spire's boss is the biblical angel you picked: one eye, wheels turning against each other, six wings.
cards.why: You asked for a biblically accurate angel, a horns ability, and four chains from the corners. Each move is a part: mark the ones that are still weak.
cards.details: One clip a stage of the fight, in order. It is still named The Gilded Seraph in the game. Say if you want a new name, and if horns meant horns on its head.

parts.title: Chains
parts.text: One chain from each of the four corners at a hero. Whoever it hits is dragged to that corner and shackled a moment.

parts.title: Trumpets
parts.text: My reading of horns: four horns in a cross with a climbing note. Break the one aimed at you; break all four and it reels.

parts.title: Wheel Within a Wheel
parts.text: The wheels leave it and drop as two eyed hoops. Step in, then out.

parts.title: Smite
parts.text: A small circle.

parts.title: Host
parts.text: Two singers halve what it takes. Kill them.

parts.title: Gaze
parts.text: Last stage: a slowly turning cone of sight. Get out of it.

cards.title: The Winter Queen
cards.text: Kept, with every move rebuilt so each asks something different and looks different.
cards.why: You said her abilities were very similar and the clones should look different. Each move is a part: mark the ones that are still weak.
cards.details: One clip a stage of the fight, in order.

parts.title: Icicle Fan
parts.text: Real crystals; pillars stop them.

parts.title: Frost Nova
parts.text: Then she blinks away. Get off her.

parts.title: Ice Wall
parts.text: With freezing mist on the cut-off side. Walk round.

parts.title: Lattice
parts.text: Beams between her and two ice mirrors. Break a mirror to break its lines.

parts.title: Blizzard
parts.text: Only a circle round her is calm. Close in.

parts.title: Her images
parts.text: Slabs of ice with her shape caught in them, not second queens.

cards.title: The Goblin Chieftain
cards.text: A two-minute fight: half the health, harder blows, six moves that each ask something else.
cards.why: You said samey, two minutes, more damage and less health. Each move is a part: mark the ones that are still weak.
cards.details: One clip a stage of the fight, in order. Wins take about 112 seconds (they took 218). The spear and the bomb barrage are gone.

parts.title: Twin Chop
parts.text: Keep out of his face.

parts.title: Charge
parts.text: The bonfires stop and daze him.

parts.title: Thrown Axe
parts.text: Step off the ring.

parts.title: War Drums
parts.text: Break them.

parts.title: Dynamite mice
parts.text: Get away.

parts.title: Whirlwind
parts.text: Last stage: run, then he is dizzy.

cards.title: The Great Ooze
cards.text: No tentacles, drawn in the slime you picked, a smaller shadow, and about an even fight now.
cards.why: You said the shadow was too big, no tentacles, too easy, and to look at its ability pool. Each move is a part: mark the ones that are still weak.
cards.details: One clip a stage of the fight, in order. The plainest of the seven: its room is unchanged and the split could use a more visible tear.

parts.title: Hop Slam
parts.text: Get out from under it.

parts.title: Roll
parts.text: The whole zig-zag shows on the floor first. Read the bounce.

parts.title: Heave
parts.text: Get off it.

parts.title: Brood
parts.text: Kill the slimes before they crawl home and heal it.

parts.title: Split and Slap
parts.text: Fight two halves, then keep out from between them.

parts.title: Meltdown
parts.text: Last stage: its landings leave gas.
